I re-derived the schedule and got the same order as before. The team note's two options don't fit the constraints.

- Elif, Finn and Gus are consecutive, in that order. Hana is right after Ben.
- Ben is before Finn and is not Elif, so Ben is before Elif. Hana is right after Ben and is not Elif, so Hana is also before Elif.
- Cara is before Dev and Dev is before Ben, so the first four slots are Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana.
- Ann is after Elif and can't sit inside the Elif, Finn, Gus block, so Ann is after Gus. Ivo is right after Ann, which gives Ann 8 and Ivo 9.
- Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five apart, which is at least three. So all constraints hold.

The note's options fail. "Ben first" is impossible because Cara and Dev must come before Ben. "Elif first" is impossible because Ben must come before Elif.
